ai.faq.delivery.a: Vendors deliver within Lusaka, and the delivery fee for your area is shown at checkout before you pay. Outside Lusaka, choose pickup from the vendor's branch.
ai.faq.pickup.q: Can I pick up my order?
ai.faq.pickup.a: Yes. Choose pickup at checkout and collect from the vendor's branch. Show the pickup code from your order page when you collect.
ai.faq.cod.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
ai.faq.cod.a: Cash on delivery is available on eligible Lusaka orders up to K500. Larger orders are paid by mobile money or card and held safely until delivery.
ai.faq.escrow.a: Yes. When you pay, Convergeo holds the money and the vendor is only paid after you receive your order: You paid → Held by Convergeo → Released.
ai.faq.payment.a: Pay with MTN or Airtel mobile money by approving the prompt on your phone, or by card through our secure checkout.
ai.faq.returns.q: What if something goes wrong with my order?
ai.faq.returns.a: Report a problem from your order page and our team will review it. Approved refunds are sent back to your mobile money.
